_about: Things Andy has learned that the engineer should remind him of. Each entry: when (session group), track_id (optional: only applies at that track; Session.trackId, 0 = Melbourne as seen in the Australia sessions), elsewhere (optional: practice_note = one note per practice session at other tracks), check (optional), text. Session groups come from Session.sessionType (F1 25 UDP spec): practice 1-4, qualifying 5-14, race 15-17, time_trial 18.

reminders.text: Pole lap 1:16.749 was done with ERS mode on NONE and deploying by hand where needed (game data: none 70%, overtake 30% of the lap). The laps on hotlap (71%) and medium (82%) were 1.147 s and 0.958 s slower.
